name: cachly-brain
description: Explain it once. Every AI knows it. cachly keeps the rules, decisions and fixes you explain to your AI and brings them back in every session, editor and model. Hosted in the EU, with a free plan.

instance_id.title: Brain instance ID
instance_id.description: Optional. Leave it empty and cachly sets itself up on first use: it opens the browser once to sign in (GitHub, Google or e-mail), and a new account gets 14 days of the Solo plan. Set this only to point at an existing brain — the UUID is in your dashboard at https://cachly.dev.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Optional. Leave it empty unless you already have a key (starts with cky_). Without one, cachly creates a trial key for you on first use and stores it in ~/.cachly/credentials.json.
